1.english_reference: My son , forget not my law

traditions.WLC: בְּ֭נִ י תּוֹרָתִ֣ י אַל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח
traditions.VUL: Fili mi , ne obliviscáris legis meæ ,
traditions.KJV: My son , forget not my law ;

1.english_reference: but let thine heart keep my commandments

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ מִצְוֺתַ֗ י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: τὰ δὲ ῥήματά μου τηρείτω σὴ καρδία ·
traditions.VUL: et præcépta mea cor tuum custódiat :
traditions.KJV: but let thine heart keep my commandments :

2.english_reference: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝ שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: μῆκος γὰρ βίου καὶ ἔτη ζωῆς καὶ εἰρήνην προσθήσουσίν σοι .
traditions.VUL: longitúdinem enim diérum , et annos vitæ , et pacem appónent tibi .
traditions.KJV: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .

3.english_reference: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee

traditions.WLC: חֶ֥סֶד וֶ אֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐλεημοσύναι καὶ πίστεις μὴ ἐκλιπέτωσάν σε ,
traditions.VUL: Misericórdia et véritas te non déserant :
traditions.KJV: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee :

traditions.LXX: ἄφαψαι δὲ αὐτὰς ἐπὶ σῷ τραχήλῳ ,
traditions.KJV: bind them about thy neck ;

3.english_reference: write them upon the table of thine heart

traditions.WLC: כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ ם עַל ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽ ךָ
traditions.VUL: et descríbe in tábulis cordis tui :
traditions.KJV: write them upon the table of thine heart :

4.english_reference: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man

traditions.WLC: וּ מְצָא חֵ֖ן וְ שֵֽׂכֶל ט֑וֹב בְּ עֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְ אָדָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ προνοοῦ καλὰ ἐνώπιον Κυρίου καὶ ἀνθρώπων .
traditions.VUL: et invénies grátiam , et disciplínam bonam coram Deo et homínibus .
traditions.KJV: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man .

5.english_reference: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart

traditions.WLC: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל יְ֭הוָה בְּ כָל לִבֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἴσθι πεποιθὼς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ καρδίᾳ ἐπὶ θεῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Habe fidúciam in Dómino ex toto corde tuo ,
traditions.KJV: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart ;

5.english_reference: and lean not unto thine own understanding

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל בִּֽ֝ינָתְ ךָ֗ אַל תִּשָּׁעֵֽן
traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ δὲ σῇ σοφίᾳ μὴ ἐπαίρου ·
traditions.KJV: and lean not unto thine own understanding .

6.english_reference: In all thy ways acknowledge him

traditions.WLC: בְּ כָל דְּרָכֶ֥י ךָ דָעֵ֑ הוּ
traditions.VUL: In ómnibus viis tuis cógita illum ,
traditions.KJV: In all thy ways acknowledge him ,

6.english_reference: and he shall direct thy paths

traditions.KJV: and he shall direct thy paths .

7.english_reference: Be not wise in thine own eyes

traditions.WLC: אַל תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּ עֵינֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.KJV: Be not wise in thine own eyes :

7.english_reference: fear the LORD , and depart from evil

traditions.WLC: יְרָ֥א אֶת יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְ ס֣וּר מֵ רָֽע
traditions.LXX: φοβοῦ δὲ τὸν θεὸν καὶ ἔκκλινε ἀπὸ παντὸς κακοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: time Deum , et recéde a malo :
traditions.KJV: fear the LORD , and depart from evil .

8.english_reference: It shall be health to thy navel

traditions.LXX: τότε ἴασις ἔσται τῷ σώματί σου ,
traditions.KJV: It shall be health to thy navel ,
and marrow to thy bones .

9.english_reference: Honour the LORD with thy substance

traditions.WLC: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת יְ֭הוָה מֵ הוֹנֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: τίμα τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ σῶν δικαίων πόνων ,
traditions.KJV: Honour the LORD with thy substance ,

9.english_reference: and with the firstfruits of all thine increase

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ מֵ רֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל תְּבוּאָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπάρχου αὐτῷ ἀπὸ σῶν καρπῶν δικαιοσύνης .
traditions.VUL: et de primítiis ómnium frugum tuárum da ei :
traditions.KJV: and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :

10.english_reference: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty

traditions.LXX: ἵνα πίμπληται τὰ ταμεῖά σου πλησμονῆς σίτῳ ,
traditions.KJV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty ,

10.english_reference: and thy presses shall burst out with new wine

traditions.LXX: οἴνῳ δὲ αἱ ληνοί σου ἐκβλύζωσιν .
traditions.KJV: and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .

11.english_reference: My son , despise not the chastening of the LORD

traditions.WLC: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣ י אַל תִּמְאָ֑ס
traditions.VUL: Disciplínam Dómini , fili mi , ne abícias :
traditions.KJV: My son , despise not the chastening of the LORD ;

11.english_reference: neither be weary of his correction

traditions.WLC: וְ אַל תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּ תוֹכַחְתּֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: nec defícias cum ab eo corríperis :
traditions.KJV: neither be weary of his correction :

12.english_reference: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ
traditions.KJV: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth ;

12.english_reference: even as a father the son [ in whom ] he delighteth

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ כְ אָ֗ב אֶת בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה
traditions.LXX: μαστιγοῖ δὲ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται .
traditions.VUL: et quasi pater in fílio cómplacet sibi .
traditions.KJV: even as a father the son [ in whom ] he delighteth .

13.english_reference: Happy [ is ] the man [ that ] findeth wisdom

traditions.KJV: Happy [ is ] the man [ that ] findeth wisdom ,

13.english_reference: and the man [ that ] getteth understanding

traditions.KJV: and the man [ that ] getteth understanding .

14.english_reference: For the merchandise of it [ is ] better than the merchandise of silver

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָ הּ מִ סְּחַר כָּ֑סֶף
traditions.LXX: κρεῖττον γὰρ αὐτὴν ἐμπορεύεσθαι ἢ χρυσίου καὶ ἀργυρίου θησαυρούς .
traditions.VUL: Mélior est acquisítio eius negotiatióne argénti ,
traditions.KJV: For the merchandise of it [ is ] better than the merchandise of silver ,

14.english_reference: and the gain thereof than fine gold

traditions.VUL: et auri primi et puríssimi fructus eius :
traditions.KJV: and the gain thereof than fine gold .

15.english_reference: She [ is ] more precious than rubies

traditions.KJV: She [ is ] more precious than rubies :

15.english_reference: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל חֲ֝פָצֶ֗י ךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ בָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: et ómnia , quæ desiderántur , huic non valent comparári .
traditions.KJV: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her .

traditions.LXX: εὔγνωστός ἐστιν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐγγίζουσιν αὐτῇ , πᾶν δὲ τίμιον οὐκ ἄξιον αὐτῆς ἐστιν .

16.english_reference: Length of days [ is ] in her right hand

traditions.LXX: μῆκος γὰρ βίου καὶ ἔτη ζωῆς ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτῆς ,
traditions.KJV: Length of days [ is ] in her right hand ; [ and ]

traditions.WLC: בִּ֝ שְׂמֹאולָ֗ הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְ כָבֽוֹד
traditions.LXX: ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀριστερᾷ αὐτῆς πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα ·
traditions.VUL: et in sinístra illíus divítiæ et glória .
traditions.KJV: in her left hand riches and honour .

traditions.LXX: ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτῆς ἐκπορεύεται δικαιοσύνη , νόμον δὲ καὶ ἔλεον ἐπὶ γλώσσης φορεῖ .

17.english_reference: Her ways [ are ] ways of pleasantness

traditions.KJV: Her ways [ are ] ways of pleasantness ,

17.english_reference: and all her paths [ are ] peace

traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ τρίβοι αὐτῆς ἐν εἰρήνῃ ·
traditions.KJV: and all her paths [ are ] peace .

18.english_reference: She [ is ] a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her

traditions.WLC: עֵץ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַ מַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: ξύλον ζωῆς ἐστι πᾶσι τοῖς ἀντεχομένοις αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Lignum vitæ est his , qui apprehénderint eam ,
traditions.KJV: She [ is ] a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her :

18.english_reference: and happy [ is every one ] that retaineth her

traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς ἐπερειδομένοις ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν ὡς ἐπὶ Κύριον .
traditions.KJV: and happy [ is every one ] that retaineth her .

19.english_reference: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth

traditions.LXX: ὁ θεὸς τῇ σοφίᾳ ἐθεμελίωσεν τὴν γῆν ,
traditions.KJV: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth ;

19.english_reference: by understanding hath he established the heavens

traditions.KJV: by understanding hath he established the heavens .

20.english_reference: By his knowledge the depths are broken up

traditions.KJV: By his knowledge the depths are broken up ,

20.english_reference: and the clouds drop down the dew

traditions.KJV: and the clouds drop down the dew .
My son ,

21.english_reference: let not them depart from thine eyes

traditions.VUL: ne éffluant hæc ab óculis tuis .
traditions.KJV: let not them depart from thine eyes :

traditions.LXX: τήρησον δὲ ἐμὴν βουλὴν καὶ ἔννοιαν ·
traditions.KJV: keep sound wisdom and discretion :

22.english_reference: So shall they be life unto thy soul

traditions.WLC: וְ יִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְ נַפְשֶׁ֑ ךָ
traditions.KJV: So shall they be life unto thy soul ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ χάρις ᾖ περὶ σῷ τραχήλῳ .
traditions.KJV: and grace to thy neck .

traditions.LXX: ἔσται δὲ ἴασις ταῖς σαρξί σου , καὶ ἐπιμέλεια τοῖς σοῖς ὀστέοις ·

traditions.WLC: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָ בֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ ךָ

traditions.VUL: Tunc ambulábis fiduciáliter in via tua ,
traditions.KJV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely ,

23.english_reference: and thy foot shall not stumble

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ πούς σου οὐ μὴ προσκόψῃ .
traditions.KJV: and thy foot shall not stumble .

24.english_reference: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid

traditions.KJV: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid :

24.english_reference: yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽ עָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.VUL: quiésces , et suávis erit somnus tuus .
traditions.KJV: yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .

25.english_reference: Be not afraid of sudden fear

traditions.KJV: Be not afraid of sudden fear ,

traditions.KJV: neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .

traditions.VUL: Dóminus enim erit in látere tuo ,
traditions.KJV: For the LORD shall be thy confidence ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρείσει σὸν πόδα ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῇς .
traditions.VUL: et custódiet pedem tuum ne capiáris .

traditions.KJV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due ,

traditions.KJV: when thou hast it by thee .

traditions.LXX: οὐ γὰρ οἶδας τί τέξεται ἡ ἐπιοῦσα .

traditions.WLC: אַל תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל רֵעֲ ךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: μὴ τεκτήνῃ ἐπὶ σὸν φίλον κακά ,

traditions.VUL: cum ille in te hábeat fidúciam .
traditions.KJV: seeing he dwelleth securely by thee .
